fields.statement: Verified at ab33bb96 (claude-opus verifier, attempt 2). Read the leaf diff (0df6bd6f + ab33bb96): internal/daemon/load.go parses /proc/loadavg and /proc/meminfo, Evaluate begins a load hold on the 1-minute load per core over maxLoad, keeps it until the 5-minute load is under (also beneath a memory-low hold), holds on MemAvailable under minMemory, 0 disables each, unknown readings never hold; daemonPoll1 treats a machine hold like disk-low (no plan requests, resumes, starts) with skips load-high/memory-low and their detail; schedules and demand stop too; running runs untouched; RHIZA_TEST_LOAD1/LOAD5/MEM_AVAILABLE apply only with RHIZA_TEST_NOW, and cmd/rhiza Setup sets idle defaults for every script. Ran: go test -trimpath ./internal/daemon/... -run 'TestParseLoadavg|TestParseMemAvailable|TestEvaluate' -v (PASS); go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(daemon-load-hold|describe-golden)$' (ok) - the script covers 1-minute over holds with load-high, 1-minute under/5-minute over stays held, 5-minute under starts the run, memory-low holds, minMemory 0 and maxLoad 0 each disable; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'Daemon|Usage|Budget|Help' - all tests PASS, only TestMain's root-state guard reported ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json changed, which the live root daemon rewrites every few seconds (mtime 2s old), unrelated to this change.
